forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {予知|よち}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: Knowing or predicting something before it happens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予知|よち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予知|よち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Technology to predict disasters is in demand.

examples.japanese: {予知|よち}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There have always been quite a few people who claim to have precognitive abilities.

notes:
Refers to predicting future events before they occur. Can be used both for scientific prediction and for supernatural foreknowledge. Also functions as a suru verb ({予知|よち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧{予知|よち} — earthquake prediction
- {予知|よち}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ — precognitive ability
- {予知|よち}{夢|ゆめ} — prophetic dream
- {予知|よち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to foresee, to predict
- {予知|よち}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ — unpredictable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧ — prediction, forecast (scientific, data-based)
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧ — expectation, forecast (general, often subjective)
- ⟦{予言|よげん}→予言：20803_yogen⟧ — prophecy (often mystical or religious)

USAGE:
{予知|よち} implies knowing something before it happens, while ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧ and ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧ are more about forecasting based on available information. ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧{予知|よち} is a frequently discussed topic in Japan.
